value.rationale: The same natural log-Bergman threshold separating bounded and unbounded Hilbert-matrix behavior has a quantitative Hilbert–Schmidt blow-up with exact residue, renormalized constant and a nontrivial doubly-exponential escape distribution. The invariant and parameter are forced by the original Hilbert-matrix/Bergman problem, not chosen as an arbitrary finite slice; the result distinguishes boundedness from operator-ideal behavior and quantifies concentration at criticality.
